scope: Static read-only schema, source-data preservation, source-fact mapping and provenance review. No HAL tests, HAL models, compilation, generated output or hardware validation.

insertion_runs.text:
/// Fixed HSIOSC divisor imposed by CCS, only when explicitly source-qualified.
    pub fixed_ccs_hsi_divisor: Option<u8>,

/// Required legal incoming HSIOSC range; not an arbitrary-TRIM frequency guarantee.
    pub hsi_operating_range_hz: Option<(u32, u32)>,

contracts.verification_method: Rust field types, derive implementation, serde attributes and unchanged Debug-based static projection inspected; these are static conclusions, not dynamically executed serde tests.
contracts.serde_absent_and_null: Both new options deserialize to None when absent or null; None serializes by omitting the key.
contracts.owned_generator_absent_and_null: Both new options deserialize to None with #[serde(default)]; owned metadata model does not implement Serialize.
contracts.width_and_shape: Some fixed divisor is u8; Some range is exactly a two-element tuple of u32. Negative, fractional, out-of-width and wrong-length inputs fail serde decoding. Semantic nonzero/ordering/source equality is generator responsibility.
contracts.static_projection: Both fields retain Option-owned scalar/tuple types. Debug prints None or Some(value); stringify leaves scalar and tuple representation intact. No new static reference or array coercion is introduced.
contracts.existing_model_fields_order_attributes_a: Byte-identical to baseline after removing the two exact insertion runs in each of three models.

data_proof.l012_range_source: Own CW32L012 User Manual CN V1.4 section 4.4.2, PDF page 59 / printed page 33; legal operating prerequisite whenever enabled, including inherited trim. It is not an actual-frequency measurement or a guarantee for arbitrary trim.
data_proof.source_verifier: python tests/verify_l012_hse_sources.py --source-only: passed against locked original PDFs, extracted text and SVD; no generated/HAL execution.

conditions_after_gate_acceptance: Nest the entire unchanged current replacement_review object as previous_review; preserve all previous_review and accepted_extensions descendants without flattening or truncating.
Record exact next serde/owned/static hashes and the independent schema receipt; preserve adapted metapac ancestry entries and historical hashes.
Retain legal_clearance false and all existing licensing caveats; this is technical review only.
provenance.reason_tip_not_advanced: Parent requested review and exact proposed identity only; candidate provenance remains untouched. The reviewed model identity is eligible when parent integrates the accepted composition and this receipt.

resolved_findings.summary: Required own-source facts can be silently omitted by the generator because option validation is conditional on presence.
cases: L012 hsi_operating_range_hz absent/null with otherwise unchanged HSE: if-let skips required own-source range comparison.
A profile with c.hse absent can carry an undeclared Some range because the range validation is nested under HSE presence.
L012 c.hse absent/null and hse_sources empty skips its required fixed-divisor/HSE fact check; preserving the valid range does not restore that check.
resolved_findings.mitigation_already_present: HAL build requires the fixed divisor for L010/L011/L012/L052 and the operating range for L012 when HSE metadata is present; source verifier requires current L012 values. These guards do not replace generator source-fact applicability.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Verify the locked own HSE policy before the optional branch and compare serialized Option HSE and Option HSI range to source values unconditionally, including absent family/key as null. Retain numeric constraints and own-family checks when present. Preserve schema and runtime bytes.
resolved_findings.proof_kind: Static control-flow proof; no generator mutation experiment or compilation performed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Accepted exact generator supplement moves policy lock, HSE Option equality and range Option equality before optional branch; retains present interval/divisor and source attribution checks.

supplement_proof.proof_method: Read-only control-flow and serialized Option equality inspection; no dynamic generator rejection claims.
cases_closed: L012 missing or null HSI range serializes to Null and differs from own [90000000,100000000].
L012 missing or null HSE serializes to Null and differs from own required HSE object.
Any declared fixed CCS divisor missing or null inside a present HSE omits its serialized key and differs from the locked source object.
Undeclared Some HSI range on any other family differs from missing own range (Null), including F002/F003 with no HSE.
An HSE object on a family without own HSE qualification differs from missing own HSE (Null).
Correct absent HSE and range on F002/F003 both compare Null equal to Null, preserving old absence compatibility.
Present zero or reversed range still fails numeric check; wrong typed values remain rejected by serde.
Present zero divisor fails before modulus; mismatched and undeclared values fail exact source equality.
